subject: Request: One-off marketplace commission & tailored SLA for Helix Analytics (AWS Private Offer)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@helixanalytics.com>
Cc: Todd Li <todd.li@helixanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: One-off marketplace commission & tailored SLA for Helix Analytics (AWS Private Offer)

Hi Erin,

Thanks again for the time earlier — great alignment on the integration timeline. Per our conversation, Helix wants to list via an AWS Private Offer and has asked for two one-off exceptions to standard marketplace terms:

- Commission: customer is requesting an 18% initial partner commission (their target to make the economics work for reselling in EMEA). Our standard marketplace commission is 15%.
- SLA amendment: Helix needs an explicit 99.95% availability SLA and an on-call escalation path for critical incidents tied to their enterprise customers.

They've also asked for net60 payment terms to match their procurement cadence. That last item is more of a billing ask, but they made it part of the deal economics.

Attached are the latest SOW and a simple commission calculation showing the impact to the Q4 ARR. If we can get executive approval for the 18% carve and the SLA amendment (with the usual clause that we can revert at renewal if usage patterns change), Helix is ready to move to DocuSign this week and wants the AWS Private Offer submitted before Nov 18 to hit their procurement window.

Questions for you: what is the appetite for a one-off commission at 18% + SLA tweak? If we approve, I propose we add a limited-time clause (180 days) and require marketplace listing language that allows us to route traffic to a lower-cost variant if needed.

Thanks — I can hop on a call if helpful.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments:
- Helix_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
- commission_calcs_HELIX.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@helixanalytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Todd Li <todd.li@helixanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-off marketplace commission & tailored SLA for Helix Analytics (AWS Private Offer)

Camila —

Really appreciate the fast turnaround and the SOW. A couple quick clarifying points from my side before we ask Redwood leadership for exceptions:

1) The 18% commission is what our channel ops team expects to make the resale margins work with the 1-year managed package we sell. If you can do 17.5% that would be easier to justify internally.
2) For the SLA: will Redwood accept incident severity definitions mapped to our CS playbooks (we'll share those)? We need a named escalation contact and a 4-hour bridge for Sev1.
3) Net60 is non-negotiable for Helix on this first purchase due to their quarter timing.

If we can get the 17.5% + named escalation contact + net60, Helix signs immediately and will push AWS to approve the Private Offer.

—Erin
Erin Cole
VP, Strategic Partnerships | Helix Analytics
erin.cole@helixanalytics.com

Team,

Forwarding Helix exchange — they countered to 17.5% commission, named Sev1 escalation contact + a 4-hour bridge, and net60 payment terms.

Impact summary (attached commission_calc):
- ARR pull-through projected if approved: +$380k incremental in year 1 (Helix 1-yr contract)
- Immediate impact to marketplace take rate if we price above standard: ~+2.5% on this listing for 12 months
- Operational ask: establish a named on-call and agree to a short SLA amendment (no change to default support scope beyond guaranteed bridge times)

Requesting:
1) Exec signoff to approve a one-off 17.5% commission for Helix for 12 months.
2) Authority to accept net60 for first invoice only (finance signoff required).
3) Approval to provide named escalation lead and 4-hour bridge for Sev1 for the initial 12-month term; add automatic re-eval at renewal.

Constraints/Conditions I recommend:
- Approval limited to this specific AWS Private Offer (deal_id DL-2026-1389).
- Include a clause that allows Redwood to revert commissions to standard list at renewal unless renegotiated.
- Finance to require a purchase order and payment plan signed in DocuSign; no revenue recognition until cash is received per net60 exception terms.

Attachments: commission calculation + draft Private Offer doc.

Happy to discuss on short notice — Helix wants to sign this week.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: One-off marketplace commission & tailored SLA for Helix Analytics (AWS Private Offer) — Exec approval needed

Camila / team,

Thanks for the concise summary. I ran the numbers and spoke with Finance. My read / recommendation:

- Commission: we can approve a one-off 17.5% for a 12-month period but require a clawback clause if Helix churns or if monthly ARR falls below projected thresholds in the first 90 days.
- Net60: Finance is nervous about cashflow impact. They'll accept net60 only with an upfront 30% deposit and a signed PO referencing Redwood's exception. If Helix cannot provide the deposit, finance requires default net30.
- SLA / Escalation: Acceptable if we limit the named on-call to our Platform Reliability lead and define the bridge as a 4-hour guaranteed callback and subject to our standard maintenance windows. No additional engineering on-call obligations.

Operational asks for approval document: include clawback language, deposit requirement (30%) or revert to net30, and a 12-month term limit tied to the Private Offer listing. Also include a clause allowing us to switch to a quantized (lower-cost) model variant after six months if utilization is materially higher than forecast.

If leadership okays the above, Deal Desk will update the Private Offer doc and I will coordinate with Legal on the clawback and SLA language.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

Team,

Thanks for the clear ask and the proposed mitigations. I approve the one-off concession on the following conditions:

1) Commission set at 17.5% for 12 months only; include the clawback if ARR drops >30% vs forecast in first 90 days.
2) Net60 permitted only with 30% up-front deposit and a signed PO referencing Redwood’s net60 exception. Finance to confirm invoicing flow and cash hold rules before DocuSign goes live.
3) SLA amendment approved as described — named Platform Reliability lead only, 4-hour guaranteed bridge, no additional on-call engineering, and subject to our maintenance windows.
4) Legal to review and sign off on the exact clawback & reversion language. Deal Desk to push updated Private Offer doc and I will personally OK the DocuSign envelope prior to sending.

Camila — proceed to update the Private Offer with Karthik and Legal. Once the DocuSign is ready, loop me and I'll countersign so you can submit to AWS by the 18th.
